name: Ksplat Decompression
definition: Decompresses a .ksplat file (compressed 3D Gaussian Splat) into a structured DataTable format for rendering, handling position quantization, scale/rotation compression, and spherical harmonics decoding.
summary: Ksplat Decompression reads compressed 3D Gaussian Splat files and converts them into structured DataTables, using spatial bucketing and three compression modes to balance file size and precision.
